title: Force System with Vertical V-Bends: A 3D In Vitro Assessment of Elastic and Rigid Rectangular Archwires
protocol: Mark the precise position for the placement of molar tubes and incisor brackets on the aluminum pegs of the OWT using a customized 'jig'.
Bond standard self-ligating brackets with composite material.
Light cure for 40 seconds.
Insert a 0.021 x 0.025-inch stainless steel (SS) 'ovoid' maxillary archwire into the bracket slots.
Place the testing apparatus in the glass chamber.
Check for any unintended archwire activation.
Reposition the brackets if any archwire activation is observed.
Repeat steps to bond, light cure, insert archwire, place testing apparatus, check for archwire activation, and reposition as necessary.
Place an archwire (0.021 x 0.025 SS) in the testing apparatus.
Use a permanent marker to indicate the midline on the archwire.
Indicate a point immediately distal to the incisor bracket (I).
Indicate a point immediately mesial to the molar tube (M).
Repeat marking points for the contralateral side of the archwire.
Transfer the marked archwire to graph paper.
Make a precise replica of the archwire on the graph paper.
Calculate the perimeter of the arch wire segment from I to M.
Mark 11 points from I to M, each representing a future V-bend position.
Label each point from a0 to a10.
Take a new archwire from the sample.
Place it on the template archwire/graph paper and transfer one of the eleven bend positions bilaterally to the archwire.
Use a rectangular archwire plier or a light wire plier to make symmetrical V-bends at both the positions.
Place the archwire on a glass slab/flat platform and check the measurement of the angle made by the two ends of the archwire with a protractor.
Adjust the ends if necessary so that an angle of 150° is created.
Repeat steps for all archwires of the sample.
Open the software program for data recording (see Table of Materials).
Create a new folder for the data to be saved in.
Click 'run' to start the software.
Wait for approximately 10-15 seconds for the fluctuations in data recording software to stop.
Ensure that the graph lines on the software for all the components of the force system show a 'flat' line.
Gently remove the 'testing apparatus' from the platform.
Use a Weingart plier to insert an archwire into the molar tubes.
Open the door of the incisor bracket with a periodontal scaler.
Lift the anterior portion of the archwire and insert it into the bracket slot.
Ensure that the midline of the archwire coincides with the midline of the testing apparatus.
Return the testing apparatus to the platform.
Close the door of the glass chamber.
Set the temperature at 37 °C.
Wait for one minute for the temperature adjustment.
Click the 'start saving' button on the software.
Allow the software to save/transfer data for at least 10 seconds.
Click the 'start saving' button again to end data transfer.
Click 'stop'.
Copy/export the saved data set to a custom designed data analysis spreadsheet.
Choose the correct V-bend position number and the specific wire sample.
Insert the data into the chosen position in the spreadsheet.
Repeat steps for the 10 archwires of that specific bend position.
Calculate means and standard deviations for the archwires.
Copy calculated means and standard deviations to a separate spreadsheet.
Create a graphical representation of the data.
Repeat steps from opening the door to creating a graphical representation for all bend positions and types of archwires.
Run the computer/software as described in steps 4.1-4.4.
Remove the testing apparatus from the platform.
Obtain a straight length 0.021 x 0.025-inch SS wire.
Using a light wire plier, bend one end of the wire into a small hook.
Insert the free end of the archwire into the molar tube from the distal side.
Place the testing apparatus back on the platform.
Attach a known weight (50 g) to the hook.
Let it hang freely in the vertical plane by removing any type of interference.
Close the door of the glass chamber.
Follow steps 4.10-4.11.
Repeat steps 5.1-5.6 for the incisor bracket.
Enter the Fz values for both the brackets and Mx for the molar tube as 'measured value.'
